name: cache-guard
description: Zero-intrusion lifecycle hook plugin that reads usage-monitor telemetry to warn on Prompt Cache TTL idle gaps, 120k/150k context bloat, and cache-hit drops without touching usage-monitor files.
suggestedPrompts: Check current session cache-guard status and thresholds
Summarize progress into HANDOFF.md before starting a new session
Customize cache-guard TTL or context warning thresholds
